entries.query: SELECT id FROM T_CMP8 WHERE v <> CAST('5' AS BIGINT) ORDER BY id

entries.name: string_range_gte_lte
entries.schema_template: CREATE TABLE T_CMP9 (id BIGINT, s STRING, PRIMARY KEY (id))
entries.query: SELECT id FROM T_CMP9 WHERE s >= 'b' AND s <= 'y' ORDER BY id

entries.name: double_gt_floating_point_sum
entries.schema_template: CREATE TABLE T_CMP10 (id BIGINT, v DOUBLE, PRIMARY KEY (id))
entries.query: SELECT id FROM T_CMP10 WHERE v > 0.1 + 0.2 ORDER BY id
